blocks.text: The Corrected Child — Characters and places to identify

Editorial identification register for Parts One and Two. Gold underlined passages in the stories link here. These notes distinguish established details from gaps; they do not add new story canon or replace your personal highlights.

Established: Valei is Lio’s caregiver and participates in decisions about developmental support.
Still unidentified: Their exact family relationship, profession, and earlier life are not established.
Source: Part One — Valei

Still unidentified: Their background remains undeveloped. Do not merge this student with other characters named Vey.

Developmental specialist with blue wrist bands

blocks.text: Other people and settings

Lio, Sen, Iri, and Aru already have identified roles in the lore. Background students remain unnamed; separate appearances should not be assumed to describe the same person. References to developmental designers or advisers do not establish that they are the review specialists. Classroom test environments are exercises, not independently identified atlas locations.
Real-world identification

Neither part identifies a real-world human character, Earth location, server site, or physical facility. A remote presence frame is mentioned, but it does not establish a physical-world location. These absences remain open questions, not invitations to invent a mapping.
